commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Alex Sola (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero Vega had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+5' The resulting free kick from Diego Rico (Getafe) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90+4' Rough tackle by Enric Franquesa (Leganes). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Luis Milla (Getafe) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' Alex Sola (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+1' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
88' Diego Rico (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
86' Alex Sola (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Raba (Leganes) replaces Juan Cruz.
83' 1 - 1 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Marko Dmitrovic to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
83' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A penalty is given to Getafe!
80' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marko Dmitrovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
80' Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to Matija Nastasic (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
78' That will be all from Bertug Yildirim who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe).
76' 0 - 1 Roberto Lopez floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes), and he smashes the ball into the top left corner to increase the score to 0:1.
74' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Miguel de la Fuente and he is replaced by Sebastien Haller (Leganes).
74' Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Enric Franquesa (Leganes).
73' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
72' The referee blows his whistle as Borja Mayoral (Getafe) was too aggressive in his challenge.
71' Getafe keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
69' Diego Rico (Getafe) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
68' Roberto Lopez (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Substitution. Djene walks off the pitch and Carles Perez (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
67' Here is a change. Christantus Uche is going off and Patricio Moreno Ruiz gives the last tactical orders to Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
67' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Rico (Getafe) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero Vega didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Substitution. Renato Tapia makes way for Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
61' Diego Rico (Getafe) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
60' Getafe are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Alex Sola (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Djene (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
53' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero Vega had an easy-decision to make.
51' The resulting corner from Diego Rico (Getafe) is cleared by the defence.
50' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Roberto Lopez (Leganes) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
49' The attendance is 13060.
47' What a chance that is! Djene (Getafe) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
46' Diego Rico (Getafe) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
46' Half-time substitution. Borja Jimenez decided to make a change. Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) is replaced by Roberto Lopez.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is replaced by Alex Sola.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
45+2' Getafe are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
42' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' The ball is cleared after Diego Rico (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
39' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Adrian Cordero Vega interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
38' Getafe take a short corner kick.
37' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
37' Djene (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
35' Djene (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Getafe keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
34' The Leganes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Luis Milla (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero Vega has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Matija Nastasic (Leganes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
27' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
23' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

22' What a wasted opportunity by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but David Soria makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
22' What a chance that is! Juan Cruz (Leganes) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
20' The game has begun to heat up. Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
19' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
19' Dangerous play by Matija Nastasic (Leganes). Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Adrian Cordero Vega blows for a foul.
14' Diego Rico (Getafe) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
14' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Adrian Cordero Vega saw the whole situation.
13' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Leganes are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
6' Djene (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
5' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
4' Looks like Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Getafe! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Adrian Cordero Vega and both teams have no complaints.
4' There's a break in play and referee Adrian Cordero Vega must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Getafe using VAR. This could be interesting!
4' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
4' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
3' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Adrian Cordero Vega blows for a foul.
2' The foul by Juan Cruz (Leganes) was seen by Adrian Cordero Vega who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
1' The first half has just begun.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Adrian Cordero Vega will supervise the game today.
